Ivy Park: Quick follow-up from the postmortem this morning. We need clear action owners for remediation, ticket links, and a RACI. Keep it tight — small hotfixs first, design spike if needed.
Liam O'Connor: I'll pick up the hotfix for request-throttling during bursts. Will spin up a Jira and aim for 6bd.
Zara Khan: I'll own the telemetry and alerts (add "post-burst 95p latency"). Can pair with Liam on load tests.
Ivy Park: Thanks. Please create one hotfix ticket and one design ticket. Label both "pm-followup" and add to the recurring-incident tracker.
Liam O'Connor: Created INF-9977: small throttling + backpressure. Target 6bd.
DevOps-bot: New Jira created by Liam: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9977 (INF-9977)
Zara Khan: Created INF-9978: backlog design spike for prioritized queues and cache priming. Target 3w.
DevOps-bot: New Jira created by Zara: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-9978 (INF-9978)
Marta Ruiz: RACI suggestion: R: Liam (hotfix), Zara (telemetry+design), A: Ivy (PM), C: Eng-oncall, I: CS + Support.
Ivy Park: Checkpoints: 48h plan update, demo after 5bd for hotfix, sign-off after 3w for design. Handoff rule: if owner OOO >3bd hand to rotation lead (Marta). Add to ticket templates.
Liam O'Connor: Assigned INF-9977 to myself and added due date. Hotfix plan: 1) quick throttle per-tenant 2) increase queue-capacity knob 3) unit + smoke tests 4) canary.
Zara Khan: Adding metric and dashboard tile now. Alert: post-burst 95p latency > 400ms for 5m. Linking both tickets in the tracker.
Ivy Park: Great. Post short updates here, link PRs/patches. If we still see recurrence after rollout, we'll consider a focused remediation sprint. Ping me @Ivy if blocked. :white_check_mark:
